reason: Ivan ruled on 2026-11-01 that sign-out is security-critical and the server revoke is authoritative. The same rule must hold on every sign-out surface, so the one shared helper is the convention to follow. No Eventar skill records it yet, so a new sign-out change would drift back to direct signOut calls.

Dev-lens review found the skill's "stays signed in on failure" claim false for a rejected token refresh (auth-js _callRefreshToken removes the session first). The helper's JSDoc had the same false claim; the skill must not repeat it.

Review round fixes (menu closed mid-sign-out hid failures; alert inside role=menu; SignOutAction had no failure-path test, and mutating its error display survived). These are the rules the next sign-out change must follow.
